donors.observation: one owner's campaign commanders were collected into Set<Card> commanders = new HashSet<>() inside GameImpl.checkStateBasedActions and asked once per card while iterating that set. CardImpl does not override hashCode and commander ids are random UUIDs, so the order of the 'move to the command zone?' questions varied from JVM to JVM whenever one owner had two commanders and both died in the same state-based-action check. The answers and the resulting game were unchanged; only the order of the questions differed, and twin replay of an otherwise identical game therefore produced two different semantic transcripts.
donors.fix: LinkedHashSet plus Comparator.comparing(Card::getName) on the exile stream: one owner's commanders are asked in graveyard order, then exiled commanders in name order. Ordering only; no Rules outcome changes.

architecture_freeze_binding.why: the Owner-signed Architecture Freeze (2026-10-10) is bound to the epoch it was signed against. Moving the live pin is not a re-signing, so config/rules_engines.json architecture_freeze keeps engine_commit, engine_artifact_sha256 and evidence_epoch on b479fe74. The two values differ from primary_engine.commit until PB-03 runs on the Lab main merge commit of this repin and the Coordinator persists a new epoch; the freeze record is re-bound then, by the Coordinator, not by a pin move.

current_boundary.how: PB-03 workflow_dispatch on the exact Lab main merge commit of this repin, persisted as a new epoch. No current-boundary epoch exists for 3cbf7741 yet, and none may be written by this repin. Until that epoch exists no FULL107/AF credit is claimed for this pin and the signed Freeze above stays bound to b479fe74. Expected effect to verify: replay of a game in which two commanders of one owner die in the same state-based-action check stops producing two different semantic_transcript_sha256 values (Lab #720). AF11 is UNKNOWN for 3cbf7741 because the AF11 adjudication covers b479fe74 only; the new epoch is not Freeze-eligible until AF11 is re-adjudicated for this pin, so the re-bind needs PB-03 plus that adjudication.
